entity: The 108 auto-revoked nonprofits with a return in the IRS e-file index
why: No source covers our 108. The Apify page reports the same kind of finding generically: 19 of 40 recently revoked orgs still had full 990 histories on record; Fox News has one org revoked by IRS error. The NTA report is blocked and not paywalled, so it's out.
